NORTH BANK · STREETERVILLE

Find the fountain.

400 N. McClurg Court, Chicago, IL 60611
At the river, in River Esplanade Park.

Scroll the map to explore. Viewpoints below include photos and map pins.Walking directions ↗

From the Riverwalk

Stay on the south bank for the across-the-river view. To reach the fountain itself, cross at Columbus Drive and continue east along the north-bank riverfront.

From Streeterville

Head toward the river at McClurg Court and North Water Street. The cascade is on the north bank, with the cannon beside the river railing.

A note on access

River Esplanade Park lists 6 a.m.–11 p.m. hours. Follow posted closures and use pedestrian paths; a scheduled spray doesn’t extend park hours.

Park access & hours ↗

THREE WAYS TO SEE IT

Same fountain. Different perspective.

01

Up close on the north bank

Stand beside the cascade in River Esplanade Park to see the falling water and the cannon’s takeoff point.

02

Across on the south bank

Look northwest from the Riverwalk opposite the fountain for the arc framed by Streeterville’s towers.

Open this viewpoint ↗Public Riverwalk · access source
03

A little higher, on the bridge

The lower-level west sidewalk of DuSable Lake Shore Drive bridge gives a longer view west toward the arc and skyline.
